html:
Greetings, Agents.


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.  

 

This Web-Warrior has gained new powers
to overcome the misunderstanding of the world
and take her responsibilities.

 

Spider-Gwen has become the graceful ghost spider 
with her new Uniform and Tier-4.

 

Agents, check out her new skills and power
by downloading the 7/11 Patch!


■ 7/11 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 7/12 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 7/10 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT) 

 

[7/12 (Wed) 3:10 (UTC+0), 7/10 (Tue) 20:10 (PDT) added]

The patch has been completed as of 7/12 (Wed) 3:08 (UTC+0), 7/10 (Tue) 20:08 (PDT). 

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances 
and the completion time will be announced once the patch has been finished.
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 

 

▣ One New Uniform

 

The Spider-Gwen <Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse> Uniform has been added.  


* The new Uniform can be purchased after the 7/11 Patch data has been applied.
* The new Uniform can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats.
(Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)  

 

 

 

▣ Spider-Gwen Tier-4

 

Spider-Gwen is now available for Tier-4 Advancement.
The attacks of the ghost spider that are hard to detect will be a great help! 
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Artifact

 

A new Artifact has been added for Spider-Gwen.
* The effects are based on the 6★ Artifact passive skill Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Spider-Gwen will now appear with the <Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse> Uniform
when activating the 5th Active Skill of Spider-Man (Miles Morales) <Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse>.

 

2. Black Widow’s Tier-4 Skill effect test has been changed to be more precise.
* The skill effects have not been changed.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

[Before]
Applies to: Self
• Increases all Basic Attacks by +45%. (7 Sec.)
• Evades 30 hits and increases damage dealt by +60% for 7s. (7 Sec.)

 

[After]
Applies to: Self
• Increases all Basic Attacks by +45%. (7 Sec.)
• Dodges 30 hits including attacks with ignore dodge, 
   and increases damage dealt by +60% when dodging for 7 Sec. (7 Sec.)

 


▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. Not being able to attack the boss normally in certain cases 
when playing World Boss: Legend <Kang the Conqueror> has been fixed.

 

2. Not being able to proceed to the next phase after destroying the force field
when playing World Boss: Legend <Kang the Conqueror> has been fixed.

 

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.

 

Thank you.
